scenarios.title: A script approves a proposal with a review token

steps.text: A maintainer makes a review token in the dashboard; it is shown once.
Only its SHA-256 is kept, with the owner, a label and an expiry.
The script posts the review with the token as a bearer; no cookie is read.
The same checks as the button: a maintainer now, the proposal's SHA-256 at the PR's head, a note to send back, the limits.
The comment is posted as the owner, saying it came through the API and naming the token.
